independent_reference.source: Multilinear extension of each 2-input truth table, hand-derived: g(a,b) = t00(1-a)(1-b) + t01(1-a)b + t10 a(1-b) + t11 ab - the unique bilinear interpolation; EXACT at binary corners (hard limit), midpoint g(0.5,0.5) = mean(truth table). Gate set per Miotti, Niklasson, Randazzo, Mordvintsev 2025 (arXiv:2506.04912; relaxed differentiable logic gates).

Conway's Game of Life transition rule (Gardner, Sci. Am. 223(4), 1970): alive' = (n==3) OR (alive AND n==2). The hand-constructed 36-wire popcount+equality circuit is evaluated at ALL 512 (center x 8-neighbor) binary configurations and must equal the rule EXACTLY on every one - a complete, exact golden over the entire input space.

Central finite-difference baseline of the soft-excitation L2 loss (common_py.autodiff.finite_diff.finite_difference_gradient, eps=1e-6) through the 2-step soft circuit - an independent numerical method (no tape). Autodiff-vs-FD agreement measured ~1.3e-11 / 1.7e-11 / 7.4e-11 relative at table-build.
